answer: A bond of 18% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in grove, and river reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 150 aliases, and each one needs its own funded dune account. A farm of 1028 identities would post 2830 proofs and burn roughly 89 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
